# `aitbc wallet eth-send`

Send plain Sepolia ETH from this node's wallet to an explicit address. Prints the unsigned transfer by default; ``--confirm`` signs and broadcasts once. Sepolia (chain id 11155111) only — every other chain id refuses, including mainnet's 1.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet eth-send [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--to` | text | — | yes | Recipient 0x address (EIP-55 or lowercase) |
| `--amount-eth` | decimal | — | yes | Sepolia ETH to send |
| `--chain-id` | integer | — | yes | EVM chain id — must be 11155111 (Sepolia) |
| `--eth-rpc-url` | text | — | no | Sepolia JSON-RPC endpoint (default: ETH_RPC_URL env/config) |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name or wallet file path on this host |
| `--max-eth` | decimal | `0.1` | no | Per-call send cap — raise explicitly for larger transfers |
| `--max-gas-gwei` | decimal | `50` | no | Gas-price ceiling in gwei — --confirm refuses to sign above it |
| `--allow-contract` | flag | `false` | no | With --confirm: allow --to to hold contract bytecode (default: refuse contracts) |
| `--confirm` | flag | `false` | no | Sign and broadcast once (default: dry run, prints the unsigned transfer) |
| `--wait` | flag | `false` | no | With --confirm: poll the receipt and print status and block |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet eth-send --to <to_address> --amount-eth <amount_eth> --chain-id <chain_id>
```
